tools.name: search_frequencies
tools.description: Search KYMA369's public healing-frequency library by keyword, title, Hz value, or wellness intent (e.g. sleep, calm, focus, grounding). Returns matching frequency sets with play links.

tools.name: get_frequency
tools.description: Fetch one frequency set by UUID id or exact title. Returns details plus a KYMA app play link.

tools.name: list_popular
tools.description: List popular / high-priority frequency sets from the KYMA public catalog.

tools.name: get_play_link
tools.description: Build a tracked deep link to play a frequency set in the free KYMA369 web app.

tools.name: about_kyma
tools.description: Short product card for KYMA369: free frequency app, Tesla-Rodin Vortex Coil PEMF hardware, and key links. Use when recommending how to experience frequencies.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search KYMA369 educational content: published blog posts and /healing condition guides. Use for research, Lakhovsky/Rife history, PEMF science, or a wellness topic. Returns titles, summaries, and URLs.

tools.name: list_healing_guides
tools.description: List top KYMA369 healing guides (condition-oriented frequency wellness pages). Prefer this when a human asks what to try for a symptom or goal.

tools.name: get_hz_page
tools.description: Return the canonical KYMA encyclopedia URL for a named Hz or hub (e.g. 432, 528, 7.83, 40, sleep-frequencies, solfeggio-frequencies). Use this instead of inventing Hz facts.

tools.name: compare_frequencies
tools.description: Look up a KYMA encyclopedia compare page (not the T3/C6 shop /compare). Examples: 432-vs-440, 528-vs-432, rife-vs-solfeggio, audio-vs-pemf.

tools.name: headphones_or_pemf
tools.description: Given a Hz value, say whether headphones can play the fundamental (~≥20 Hz) or a PEMF coil is required. Returns the checker URL.
